verdict.rationale: Mangopay is API-first: its docs invite users to 'explore all Mangopay's features' through the Sandbox API, it publishes an OpenAPI spec and SDKs in six languages, and its webhook setup treats the Dashboard as one option rather than the only path. No document states that the API matches the UI, and some steps appear to need the Dashboard, such as reading the Web Profiler URL from the API credentials screen and accepting or refusing test payins on a UI screen. missing for 10: an explicit statement or matrix showing API/UI parity, API equivalents for Dashboard-only actions (profiler URL retrieval, test payin acceptance), and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Start calling the Sandbox API to explore all Mangopay's features
If using the Dashboard, navigate to Developers > Webhooks > Add webhook, then select the event type and enter your URL.
